zendure_ha_solarflow.json.source: Derived from the source code of Zendure-HA (Zendure/Zendure-HA) at commit 8d59bac4a5adabe16003f24330e1e42922b048b1 (master, 2026-10-11; custom_components identical to release 1.4.4 at e71b0b83be2e5909fbaf1cd931ad6a530a2be234 apart from the manifest version) on 2026-10-30 (entity.py, sensor.py, device.py, manager.py, api.py, migration.py, devices/solarflow800.py, devices/hyper2000.py, translations/de.json); not read from a real installation. zendure_ha_solarflow.json.real: platform zendure_ha; unique id format snakecase('<device name lower case>_<property key>') (camelCase keys split: aggrCharge -> aggr_charge), entity id = sensor.<unique id> (internal_integration_suggested_object_id, independent of the language); keys, units, device and state classes (aggr_* kWh energy total_increasing, total_kwh energy_storage measurement, available_kwh energy_storage without state class, roundtrip_efficiency without device class, soh without device class); German entity names from translations/de.json; device structure (main device identified by deviceKey and serial, packs as own devices named '<model> <last 5 serial chars>' via_device the main serial, a 'Zendure Manager' device with total_kwh/available_kwh/global_soc/power); pack model and nominal capacity from the serial (C..E. = AB2000X 1.92 kWh, C..H. = AB2000 1.92 kWh); available_kwh = (SoC - minSoc) / 100 x capacity; bat_in_out = packInputPower - outputPackPower (positive = discharging); nothing is disabled by default.
zendure_ha_solarflow.json.made_up: device keys, serial numbers, product model ids, every state value, minSoc 10 % behind available_kwh; that the SF800 Pro has no expansion pack and the Hyper exactly two; that the cloud reports a soh for these packs (the key exists in createEntity, but which pack models send it is not checked).
